item.title: My weight loss milestone
item.description:
July 2026
July 2026
June 2016
September 2018
September 2024 I've been working with a dietician and have been on a "weight loss journey" for quite awhile, currently down from 320 to 190 as of today. I can officially fit my entire body into one pant leg from jeans I wore religiously in 2024. I can also now fit in a medium size unisex tee. I'm in my mid 40s and I haven't been this small since I was 18. Cutting out sweets along with staying in a calorie deficit and exercising has been successful for me. I didn't really have anyone to share my exciting news with, so I figured I'd share with you all lol.
